metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the BibTeX-compatible CLI tool as a no-deps Rust (2021) Cargo project under `output/` (binary: `bibtexish`).

- Build: `cargo build --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml`
- Run: `cargo run --release --manifest-path output/Cargo.toml -- --bib <file.bib> --style <file.bst> (--cites <keys.txt> | --aux <file.aux>) --output <out.bbl> [--log <log.json>]`
- Success (exit `0`): writes the generated `.bbl` (LF, UTF-8, 79-column wrapping) to `--output`
- Failure (exit `1`): writes the specified error JSON (plus any accumulated warnings) to `--output`
- Panic/unexpected internal error (exit `2`): prints to stderr and exits `2`
